args.body:
Dear Tailspin Ltd,

We have resolved your issue regarding the hardware shipped to the wrong site. A credit of 45 has been applied to your account for the reshipping fee.

The hardware is now confirmed as shipped to your registered location (Austin DC), and your refund eligibility has been updated in our records.

Let us know if you need any further assistance.

Best regards,
IT Operations Team
